name: CalcudokuPress — Calcudoku (Mathdoku) Puzzle Book Generator with Proven Unique Solutions, 4x4-6x6, Print-Ready PDF (Local)
description:
How do I make a Calcudoku book where every cage target is actually reachable and every puzzle has exactly one solution? Both come from the same shortcut — drawing cages first and hoping the arithmetic works out.
CalcudokuPress builds in the order that can't lie:
- A complete Latin square is generated first.
- Cages are partitioned over it, and every cage's operation and target are computed FROM the true values — targets are reachable by construction, never wished into existence.
- Then an independent solver counts the solutions. Not one? The partition is thrown away and redrawn. A puzzle reaches your book only when the count is exactly ONE and the found solution is the printed one.
Three sizes — 4x4 (Easy), 5x5 (Medium), 6x6 (Hard) — with addition and multiplication cages throughout, plus subtraction and exact-division cages on Medium and Hard. One puzzle per page with heavy cage borders and clear cage labels, full solutions at the back, print-ready 8.5x11in PDF. Pick a seed and the same book rebuilds identically. And it's fast: the 6-puzzle acceptance book (all three sizes) generated and fully verified in about half a second.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
The acceptance book was re-checked by an independent solver that rebuilds constraints from the printed cage data alone and searches cage-by-cage: 6/6 puzzles have exactly one solution equal to the printed grid, cages partition the grid contiguously, and every target is arithmetically true of its solution.
Mathdoku book software launches at $67 and up; calcudoku rides inside paid bundles with no uniqueness proof at all. CalcudokuPress is $29 once, proof included, 100% on your computer. Windows 10/11. A sample book is included so you can inspect the output first.
